p.question: Why did sign-ups drop this week, and what should we do?
p.answer:
Sign-ups dropped because the new phone number field on the sign-up screen crashes. It came in with release 2.8.0 and the crash is on record as hitting that screen. The fix is built but not live.

**What happened, in order**
1. New accounts fell from about 238 a day on 28 Sep to about 51 on 15 Oct [[business:shiftly]]. Visits held: sign-up screen views were 397 on 28 Sep and 392 on 15 Oct [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]].
2. People stop at the phone number step. "Phone number entered" went from 306 on 28 Sep to 58 on 15 Oct [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]]. Phone check passes fell from 257 to 50 with it [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]].
3. That step sits on the sign-up screen [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]]. The crash is "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'country')", first seen 7 Oct. About 218 users were hit by 15 Oct [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]].
4. Release 2.8.0 brought the new field and reached everyone on Android on 7 Oct [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]]. Crash-free sessions fell from 99.68% on 3 Oct to 92.45% on 15 Oct [[channel:app]].
5. Farhan owns the fix, 2.8.1, and it is still in progress [[task:ship-hotfix-2-8-1]].

How sure: the crash on this screen and the release that brought it are on record. The funnel data shows the drop starting on the same day. Nothing is recorded that ties the exact lost sign-ups to the crash, so that last link is likely, not proven.

**Where the fix stands (as of 2026-10-15)**
- 2.8.1 was built on 13 Oct. It handles the case where no country is detected [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]].
- iPhone 2.8.1 has waited for App Store review since 13 Oct. Android 2.8.1 is built and waiting for sign-off [[document:store-status]].
- On 10 Oct Rhea chose to fix forward, not roll back. A rollback would also remove the new job feed [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]].
- You said last week not to message users until the fix is shipping, then keep it to two lines [[memory:growth-001-1]]. The crash was first raised on 9 Oct [[turn:growth-001]].

**What else it hits**
- One step away: the Pune shift jobs Meta ads send people to this screen [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]]. Ad money (sample numbers) may be going to a crashing step.
- Four steps away: phone check feeds Job-alert SMS [[feature:job-alert-sms]], Referral invites [[feature:referral-invites]] and Profile completed [[feature:seekers-signup-profile-completed]]. Further on are employers' applicant inbox [[feature:employer-applicant-inbox]] and the first-hire-in-7-days promise to employers [[feature:employer-first-hire-promise]].

**Not in the records:** a ship date for 2.8.1, and any iPhone 2.8.0 release. A paused ad or a search change is not the cause. Visits held steady and the drop starts on the release day.

**Waiting for your OK**
1. A fix task for Farhan: Android sign-off today, chase App Store review, give a ship date.
2. A two-line note to users, to send only once 2.8.1 is shipping: "Sign-up is fixed in the latest update. Please update the app, then try again with your phone number."

Not drafted yet: pausing the Pune ads until the fix is live. Say if you want it.

Approve the fix task for Farhan now; it takes under a minute.

p.question: Did pausing the Meta ads cause the sign-up drop?
p.answer:
Almost certainly not. Sign-ups dropped first, and the Meta ads were paused three days later.

- New accounts fell from about 238 a day to about 50 a day, with the step on 2026-10-07 [[business:shiftly]].
- Phone sign-ups fell from about 199 a day before 2026-10-07 to about 11 after. Google sign-ups stayed flat: 40 on 2026-09-28 and 42 on 2026-10-15 [[channel:app]].
- Meta spend (sample numbers) averaged about ₹9,266 a day, then went to ₹0 on 2026-10-10 [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]]. The exact pause date isn't recorded, so 10 Oct is the best read.
- Not recorded: sign-ups split out by Meta. The pause may have added a small loss after 2026-10-10, but I can't show it.
- Not recorded: why phone sign-ups fell on 2026-10-07. Earlier today your team tied the drop to the crash on the new phone number field, which came in with release 2.8.0 [[turn:2026-10-16-875f24c1]]. Treat that as the lead, not proof.
- The Meta ad campaign sends people to the sign-up screen [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]]. If you restart ads before the fix is live, you pay to send people to a crashing screen.

Data runs to 2026-10-15.

Next action: approve the 2.8.1 sign-up crash fix task that's waiting for your OK [[approval:turn:2026-10-16-875f24c1-1]], and keep Meta paused until it's live.

What your records do show:
- The phone-number box came in with release 2.8.0 and reached all Android users on 7 October [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]].
- The crash on that box is logged as "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'country') in PhoneInput" [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. That is an error log, not a customer's words.
- The fix, 2.8.1, was built on 13 October [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]]. As of 2026-10-15, the iPhone build is still waiting for App Store review and Android is waiting for sign-off [[document:store-status]].

Star ratings, review dates and quotes for either store in this period are not recorded.

Next step: open both store dashboards and send Imran the reviews posted since 7 October that mention the phone box. This takes about 10 minutes.
